= Empty caption references
:listing-caption: Listing
:xrefstyle: full

Full: <<figure>>; <<table>>; <<example>>; <<listing>>.

Short: xref:figure[xrefstyle=short]; xref:table[xrefstyle=short]; xref:example[xrefstyle=short]; xref:listing[xrefstyle=short].

Basic: xref:figure[xrefstyle=basic]; xref:table[xrefstyle=basic].

Overrides: xref:table[Explicit *label*]; xref:labelled[xrefstyle=short]; <<labelled>>.

Untitled: <<untitled>>; xref:untitled[xrefstyle=short].

Controls: xref:spaced[xrefstyle=short]; <<spaced>>; xref:custom[xrefstyle=short]; <<custom>>; xref:numbered[xrefstyle=short]; <<numbered>>.

.Figure _title_
[caption=""]
